chunks: From him, from Usman ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When one of you remembers a favor of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, let him place his cheek upon the dust in gratitude to Allah. So if he is riding, let him descend and let him place his cheek upon the dust; and if he is not able to descend due to publicity, let him place his cheek upon his saddle bow; and if he is not able, let him place his cheek upon his wrist, then let him praise Allah upon whatever He has favored him with.
ai.seo_question: What is the proper physical etiquette for showing gratitude when remembering a blessing from Allah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes prostrating the cheek on the earth as a physical manifestation of *shukr al-ni'mah*, emphasizing that true gratitude requires lowering oneself from pride, even if it means dismounting from a mount for the sake of sincerity. The gradation of actions—from lying on the ground to placing the cheek on the hand—demonstrates the principle of *tadarru'* (humble supplication) while accommodating practical constraints, reflecting the Shia emphasis on balancing spiritual depth with social reality.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever one of you remembers a Favour of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, so let him place his cheek upon the dust is gratitude to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So if he was riding, so let him descend and let him place his cheek upon the dust; and if he does not happen to be able upon the descending due to the publicity, so let him place his cheek upon his saddle bow; and if he is not able, so let him place his cheek upon his wrist, then let him praise Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> has Favoured upon him’.
en.sarwar: 25. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Ammar from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“When any of you may remember or speak of the bounties of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, he should place his cheek on the soil as an expression of gratitude to Allah. If one is riding one should dismount and place one’s cheek on the soil. If he is not able to do so because of his avoiding publicity, should place his cheek on the saddle. If this also cannot be done he should place his cheek on his palm, then thank Allah for the favor that He has done for him.”
